name: frt_debt_charges_pct_revenues_dof
source: Spring Economic Update 2026, Annex 1, Table A1.7. Derived as public debt charges divided by budgetary revenues.
source_label: Department of Finance Canada, Spring Economic Update 2026
is_forecast_note: FY2024-25 is the last actual anchor from SEU Table A1.7. FY2025-26 through FY2030-31 are DoF projections derived from Table A1.7 public debt charges divided by budgetary revenues.
concept_note: Same concept as PBO's debt-service ratio: public debt charges relative to total budgetary revenues. DoF does not label this as a separate debt-service-ratio line in Annex 1, but Table A1.7 provides both components for a direct derivation.
